doctrine: UPSTREAM DEFINES INTENT. DOWNSTREAM INCREASES FIDELITY.

verdicts.REVISE: Keep the territory, change named aspects → stays AUTHORITY_IN_REVIEW.
verdicts.REJECT: Territory removed from consideration (status REJECTED); if fewer than 3 remain → AUTHORITY_TERRITORIES_REQUIRED.
verdicts.COMBINE: Hybrid authority (e.g. A structure + C material) — combination map required → approval.
verdicts.REQUEST_FOURTH_TERRITORY: Author an additional territory → stays AUTHORITY_IN_REVIEW.

review_packet: experience contract summary (actor, task, states, metaphor, hierarchy)
3 territories (each with page logic + structure dimensions)

review_ui.note: Methodology + data contract first. No Studio OS UI was changed in this sprint; the review workspace consumes the registries when built.
